estimand: P(T_fill <= t and T_fill < T_cancelACK | do(placement_action), x0)

lineage.v4_role: benchmark fill model and auditable fill/cancel/no-event simplex; all six fill curves calibrated on Development
lineage.v5_status: closed on Development; trailing role offset redistributed cancel error
lineage.v6_status: closed on Development; inner-OOF role/cause Platt maps did not transport to full outer-train refits
lineage.not_rejected: the placement fill estimand and existence of a useful fill ranker

lifecycle.activation: action-specific exchange activation after new-order latency and post-only acceptance
lifecycle.fill_before_request: dynamic order-level fill process while the order is active
lifecycle.cancel_request: deterministic replay of the frozen baseline policy schedule and path triggers
lifecycle.cancel_ack: cancel request plus an empirical request-to-ACK latency draw conditional on the frozen environment identity
lifecycle.pending_cancel: the order remains fillable until ACK; partial/full fill may precede ACK and ACK cancels only remaining quantity

policy_parity: cancel-request time and reason match frozen baseline replay by side, role, action and UTC day
scheduled TTL/requote and path-trigger requests are reported separately
request timing is not learned by a stationary cancel hazard
latency_parity: request-to-ACK distribution is calibrated on past-only data
median, upper quantiles and tail exceedance are reported by environment identity
latency draws are shared across paired actions by fixed seed
fill_cif: fill probability uses the policy-derived cancel survival boundary
probability simplex and time/distance monotonicity pass
day-clustered fill calibration and proper-score intervals pass
pending-cancel fills and queue reset are included

evidence_governance.validation: sealed until all three frozen gates pass on Development
evidence_governance.sealed_holdout: unread until an independent promotion controller authorizes access
